in_marathi.name: Girilal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord Vishnu's lamp
in_marathi.long_meaning: Girilal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Girilal is derived from the Sanskrit words 'giri' meaning mountain and 'lal' meaning lamp or light. This name signifies Lord Vishnu's lamp that illuminates the path and removes darkness. It is a name of great spiritual significance in Hindu tradition.
